subject.title: [Feature]: Intelligent Model Fallback with Wildcard/Auto Selection

question: Should OpenClaw add a core provider-family fallback contract here, and if so should it be wildcard/auto refs, grouped fallbackFamilies, catalog-derived candidates, or a different single shape?
rationale: This affects public config, provider/auth routing, failover order, and operator cost expectations, so code inspection cannot choose the permanent product contract safely.

options.title: Design one core family fallback contract
options.body: Pick one schema and runtime rule for provider-family fallback, then implement it consistently across config, runtime, docs, and doctor surfaces.

options.title: Keep explicit flat fallbacks only
options.body: Close or narrow this feature direction and continue requiring operators to maintain explicit ordered fallback lists.

options.title: Route pre-selection to plugins
options.body: Use before_model_resolve or catalog-refresh plugins for pre-run model selection while leaving failure-time fallback behavior explicit-only.

recommendation.title: Design one core family fallback contract
recommendation.body: Pick one schema and runtime rule for provider-family fallback, then implement it consistently across config, runtime, docs, and doctor surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: The fallback/config history points to steipete as the strongest current routing owner for the product-contract decision.
